sections.line: A startup needs something very easy; building from the bottom up ended in one anyway.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Narrow, easy, scalable; provenance and determinism; a site from a QR code; each layer learnt on its own.

sections.label: What a startup needs
sections.line: Find something very easy, narrow and scalable; SG/Send taught that the use case must be there.

sections.label: From the bottom up
sections.line: Provenance, understanding, determinism, no black magic, and the result is simple for the person.

sections.label: The layers
sections.line: CI first, zero knowledge, selling, sgit, vaults, QR codes, agentic teams, the factory.

sections.label: Connecting the dots
sections.line: Connecting them was possible because each was lived and understood; not in love with any technology.

sections.label: Why this is the moat
sections.line: Open code can be copied; the order of learning and the velocity cannot.

sections.label: What this does not claim
